title: Wikipedia: Accounts payable
summary: Describes the accounts payable function: invoices received from vendors, matched to purchase orders and receiving records, approved, and paid, with supplier statements and approved expense reports as supporting documentation. Motivates FN01, FN02, FN05, FN06, FN07, and FN08 as readings of the documents and messages that function handles; encyclopedic motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Invoice
summary: Describes what an invoice contains, related documents such as credit memos and statements, and the payment terms an invoice states. Motivates FN01 as a document-type reading and FN03 as a reading of the terms clause; encyclopedic motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Net D
summary: Describes net-days payment terms such as net 30 and early-payment discount notation. Motivates FN03 as a classification of the kind of terms expression; the day count and due date are resolved in code. Encyclopedic motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Remittance advice
summary: Describes remittance advice as a payer's notice of a payment and the invoices it covers, used to match payments to invoices. Motivates FN05 as a message-intent reading and FN08 as a memo-consistency reading; encyclopedic motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.

title: Wikipedia: Variance (accounting)
summary: Describes budget-versus-actual and standard-cost variances, favorable and unfavorable directions, and variance analysis as the practice of explaining them. Motivates FN04 as a check on whether commentary explains a variance and FN06 as a reading of budget requests; the variance itself is computed in code. Encyclopedic motivation, not evidence of Jev performance.
